sections.title: Getting started
sections.blurb: Read in order. It ends with a complete game.

sections.title: Concepts
sections.blurb: How the engine thinks: its packages, its two backends, the scene graph, determinism, coordinates, quality and the shape of a frame.

sections.title: DriftScript
sections.blurb: The engine's scripting language and how a game uses it: what belongs in a script and what stays in TypeScript, setting it up, the patterns the examples use, every function a script can call, and testing and shipping it.

sections.title: Rendering
sections.blurb: Everything that puts pixels on the screen: meshes and materials, lights and shadows, the sky, the air and water, DriftLight and DriftRay, post-processing, the GPU-driven pipeline, and passes of your own.

sections.title: Worlds
sections.blurb: Ground and the worlds built on it: terrain, worlds bigger than a float, hierarchical detail, worlds built from a kit, procedural solids, splats, textures as programs, streaming, and capture from video.

sections.title: Simulation
sections.blurb: Everything that moves on the fixed clock: rigid bodies and their queries, characters, vehicles, ragdolls and cloth, animation, navigation, entities, chemistry and agents.

sections.title: Content
sections.blurb: Getting what artists make into a game: importing models, the .drft container and how it streams, sound and music, and the tools that bake and check them.

sections.title: Interface
sections.blurb: How a player reaches the game, and what they see: every input device through one action map, cameras that cut between shots and fly keyed paths, the 2D layer of sprites and tilemaps, menus built as a tree, and a WebXR session read every frame.

sections.title: Systems
sections.blurb: What a game keeps, shares and ships: saves and preferences, networking and rollback, recorded clips, the window and the host, and packaged applications.

sections.title: Tools
sections.blurb: Looking inside a running game: the panels a shipped build can carry, and the instruments beside them.
